E1291

Jetos real tier could not map every system declaration to NixOS.

What

Jetos real tier could not map every system declaration to NixOS.

Why

D-JOS-NIXBACKEND1=C generates a hidden NixOS backend from the checked `SystemPlan` and refuses to silently drop an option, service, or package it cannot translate — every unmapped declaration is listed together, before `nix` ever runs.

Fix

rename or drop the unmapped keys/packages/services, or map them to the nearest supported real-tier option (see the option/service/package mapping table for `--real`).
